verdict.rationale: ClickHouse describes itself as an open-source DBMS with a public GitHub repo and a one-line installer. Its docs cover running it on your own machine, and clickhousectl can launch and manage local servers. Community reports corroborate production self-hosting, from single-node desktops and official Docker images for a 3-node cluster to 12-node and 40-node deployments. Missing for 10: first-party evidence in the pack of production-grade self-hosted cluster deployment guidance (the install page is framed around build/test/experiment), and a reported failure running in unprivileged OpenShift containers.
